[P2] Revisit the incompatible enum rename under rules 3 and 10

An unset `StepConfig` now returns a different enum singleton, changing legacy `== AT_LEAST_ONCE_PER_RETRY` checks and potentially failing existing exhaustive switches even when async semantics are unused. The description acknowledges this incompatibility but still justifies the rename through JS #1296 and the new documentation names; ADR-006 addresses async completion only. Rule 10 rejects another SDK's design as justification, and rule 3 requires the Java API change's problem, cause, alternatives, and chosen rationale. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and evaluate the rename separately from async checkpointing, including preserving existing enum identities as a simpler direction.
